name: Wallpaper Roulette
author: keegan-sucks
description: Rotates through your wallpapers on a timer and switches the Omarchy theme to match each one. Point it at a folder of wallpapers organized by theme, or leave it on the built-in Omarchy wallpapers.

barWidget.description: Auto-rotate wallpapers and match the theme to each one

schema.label: Wallpaper directory
schema.description: Folder of wallpapers laid out as <dir>/<theme-slug>/image (e.g. ~/.config/omarchy/backgrounds). The parent folder name selects the matching Omarchy theme. Leave empty to rotate the built-in Omarchy wallpapers of every installed theme.

schema.label: Rotate every (minutes)
schema.description: How often to switch to a new random wallpaper.

schema.label: Auto-rotate
schema.description: Rotate automatically on the timer. Turn off to only change on click. Right-click the bar icon to toggle this.

schema.label: Match theme to wallpaper
schema.description: When a wallpaper's parent folder is an installed theme, switch to that theme as the wallpaper changes.

schema.label: Notify on change
schema.description: Send a desktop notification each time the wallpaper rotates.

schema.label: Bar glyph
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar.
